listing.name: Planning Poker & Story Points - PokerLane
listing.description:
Estimate story points without leaving Trello. Click **Estimate** on any card, your team picks poker cards in secret, and PokerLane reveals the average, median and distribution so you can agree fast. Every board gets one permanent voting-room link — perfect for distributed refinements where not everyone has the Power-Up.

![pokerlane-demo.gif](https://pokerlane.vercel.app/pokerlane-demo.gif)

**📋 How It Works**

Open any card and click **Estimate**. Then:

1. **Deal the round** — the team picks from the Fibonacci deck (0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21, ?, ☕).
2. **Vote in secret** — every vote stays hidden until you reveal, so nobody is anchored.
3. **Reveal** — see the average, median, suggested value, agreement % and a vote distribution.
4. **Agree** — set the final estimate. The suggested value is highlighted, but you decide — pick any card, even one that didn't win.
5. **Done** — the agreed story points land on the card as a badge.

Example: in sprint refinement, four teammates estimate "Build the new pricing page" — three say 5, one says 8. PokerLane suggests 5 at 75% agreement; you set it and move on in seconds.

**🔗 The Shareable Voting Room**

Every board has **one stable link that never changes**. Send it to remote teammates, contractors or stakeholders and they vote from the browser — no install, no account. Votes sync live in both directions with the card view in Trello.

**⚡ Features**

- ♠ Estimate any card with classic Planning Poker
- 🙈 Votes hidden until the facilitator reveals
- 📊 Average, median, distribution, consensus & a suggested value
- 🎯 Set any final value — even one that didn't win
- 🏷️ Agreed story points shown as a card badge
- 🔗 One stable public voting room per board (no install for guests)
- 🎨 Brand the room with your logo & title (Pro)
- 🃏 Custom decks — T-shirt sizes, powers of two, your own (Pro)
- ⏱️ Round timer & velocity history with CSV export (Pro)

**💰 Pricing**

Free forever on **1 board** with the Fibonacci deck, voting, reveal and averages — plus the public voting room. Need more? Upgrade:

- **Monthly:** $5/month
- **Annual:** $50/year *(save ~17%)*
- **Mensal (BRL):** R$ 25,90/mês
- **Anual (BRL):** R$ 259,99/ano *(economize ~16%)*

**Pro** unlocks unlimited boards, a branded voting room (your logo + title), custom decks, a round timer, and velocity history with CSV export.

**Team:** Pro for you and up to 9 teammates on one subscription. You add people by their Trello username and can change the list any time.

- **Monthly:** $19/month
- **Annual:** $190/year

Pro is per person: it unlocks PokerLane for the account that pays. Team covers everyone you add.

**🌟 Popular Ways to Use It**

- **Sprint refinement:** estimate the backlog together in minutes.
- **Distributed teams:** remote folks vote via the link — no Power-Up needed.
- **Async estimation:** drop the room link in Slack and collect votes over the day.
- **Client-facing scoping:** share a branded room to size work with a stakeholder.
- **Roadmap sizing:** quickly T-shirt-size epics before planning.
- **Velocity tracking:** export agreed points to CSV for your charts.

**⚙️ What PokerLane Enables You to Do**

♠ **Estimate in context** — poker right on the card, no tab-switching.

🙈 **Stay unbiased** — hidden votes prevent anchoring on the loudest voice.

📊 **Decide with data** — average, median, distribution and agreement at a glance.

🎯 **Keep control** — the facilitator sets the final value, always.

🔗 **Include everyone** — one stable link brings remote teammates in instantly.

📈 **Track velocity** — a history of agreed estimates, exportable to CSV (Pro).

🔒 **Protect Your Data** — We never store your card content. We keep only the board's PokerLane settings, the current round's display names and votes, the agreed estimate, and your subscription status. Built to GDPR & LGPD principles; data is erased when you revoke access.
listing.overview: Scrum Planning Poker on Trello cards: vote, reveal, agree on story points, and share one stable link so the team votes without installing.

card.desc:
**Persona:** Usuário da plataforma (motorista e proprietário)

**Ambiente:** Plataforma do E-Parking - App e Web

**Objeto:** Pagamento

**Ação:** Processar pagamentos, transferências e reembolsos, e emitir comprovantes do usuário

**Resultado:** O usuário motorista tem o controle e o histórico das suas transações dentro do app, e o proprietário, tem o balanço financeiro do dia, semana e mês.

**User Story:** Como motorista, quero ter acesso às informações das minhas atividades dentro do app, poder ter o controle dos meus gastos, e onde gastei, podendo saber, inclusive, se foi uma boa escolha. Se for o caso inclusive de poder pedir o reembolso da minha reserva. Já como proprietário, quero poder ter o controle dos meus fluxos, tanto diários, como semanais e até mensais.

**Objetivo:** Processamento de pagamentos digitais, emissão de comprovantes em PDF/digital, cálculo de transferências monetárias e consolidação de balanço financeiro periódico para a gestão do proprietário.
card.name: Processamento de Pagamentos e Balanço Financeiro

card.desc:
**Persona:** Usuário da plataforma - Proprietário 

**Ambiente:** Plataforma do E-parking - Web 

**Objeto:** BI (Business Intelligence) 

**Ação:** Consultar relatórios e indicadores sobre a ocupação das vagas, faturamento e desempenho do estacionamento. 

**Resultado:** Visualizar dados organizados em gráficos e relatórios para acompanhar o desempenho do estacionamento e auxiliar na tomada de decisões.

**User Story:** Como proprietário de estacionamento, quero visualizar relatórios e gráficos sobre a ocupação das vagas, faturamento e movimentação do meu estabelecimento, para que eu possa acompanhar os resultados, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e tomar decisões mais eficientes na gestão do meu negócio.

**Objetivo:** Dashboard de BI na Web composto por gráficos dinâmicos de ocupação ao vivo, faturamento acumulado, cálculo de média de lucro, resumo financeiro e relatórios exportáveis.
